en.title: GPT Image 2.6 launch offer: 20% off
en.summary: All four Flare and Sunburst models, text-to-image and image-to-image, are included. All users save 20% in the API and Playground during the offer.
en.content_html:
GPT Image 2.6 launch offer: 20% off

GPT Image 2.6 is OpenAI's new image generation model, with 1K/2K/4K resolution, 15 aspect ratios and five quality tiers from low to max.

  • Flare (gpt-image-2.6-flare/text-to-image, gpt-image-2.6-flare/image-to-image): faster output, suited to rapid iteration.
  • Sunburst (gpt-image-2.6-sunburst/text-to-image, gpt-image-2.6-sunburst/image-to-image): detail-focused, keeping details more consistent across edits at medium quality and above.
  • Text-to-image returns PNG, JPEG and WebP, plus SVG vectors and GIF animations; image-to-image accepts up to 16 reference images.

Runs from November 6, 2026 at 22:00 to November 13, 2026 at 22:00 (UTC+8). Automatically applied to all users in the API and Playground across every resolution, quality tier, SVG, GIF and reference-image fee. No coupon needed. Cannot be combined with other model pricing offers.

  • Flare（gpt-image-2.6-flare/text-to-image、gpt-image-2.6-flare/image-to-image）：出图更快，适合快速迭代。
  • Sunburst（gpt-image-2.6-sunburst/text-to-image、gpt-image-2.6-sunburst/image-to-image）：更重细节，medium 及以上质量下多轮编辑细节更一致。
  • 文生图支持 PNG、JPEG、WebP，以及 SVG 矢量图和 GIF 动图输出；图生图最多 16 张参考图。

活动时间：2026 年 11 月 6 日 22:00 至 11 月 13 日 22:00（北京时间）。全体用户自动享受 8 折，API 与 Playground 均可参与，所有分辨率、质量档、SVG、GIF 和参考图费用都按折后价计费，无需优惠码，不与其他模型价格优惠叠加。

en.content_html:
Kling 4.0 launch offer: 20% off

Kling 4.0 is Kuaishou's latest video model. It generates picture and synchronized audio together, with clips up to 30 seconds at 720p or 1080p.

  • Text-to-Video (kling-4.0/text-to-video): turn a prompt into a clip in 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 or 21:9.
  • Image-to-Video (kling-4.0/image-to-video): pair a first-frame image with a motion prompt for a 3–30 second clip; framing follows the source image when unspecified.

en.title: HappyHorse 1.0 Launch · 25% Credits Back
en.summary: Spend on HappyHorse 1.0 during the launch window and earn 25% back as credits — capped at $100 per user, usable on every model.
en.content_html:
Promotion Rules

  • During the promotion, get 25% credits back on net spend with the HappyHorse 1.0 model
  • Cap of $100 per user
  • Rebated credits work across all models and never expire
  • Rebated credits do not trigger referral commission (no 5% recharge commission for inviters on this amount)
  • Net spend = charges − refunds (HappyHorse 1.0 only)
  • Window: Beijing time 2026-05-08 20:00 → 2026-05-15 20:00
  • Settlement: batch payout on May 16

How to Join

  1. Sign in to your hiapi account
  2. Top up and call the happyhorse-1-0 model
  3. Spend tracks automatically; rebate lands May 16 — no signup required

FAQ

Do I need to opt in? No — any qualifying spend during the window counts.

Can I keep the rebated credits? Yes, they're permanent and work across every model.

How are refunds handled? We rebate on net spend (charges minus refunds), so refunds reduce the rebate proportionally.

When do credits arrive? Within May 16 (Beijing time), as a single payout per user.

zh.summary: 活动期内使用 HappyHorse 1.0 模型，按净消费 25% 返额度，单用户上限 $100，返出的额度全模型可用。
zh.content_html:
活动规则

  • 活动期间使用 HappyHorse 1.0 模型，按净消费的 25% 返额度
  • 每位用户返额上限 $100
  • 返出的额度 全模型通用，永久有效
  • 返出的额度 不参与邀请返佣（不计入邀请人的 5% 充值返佣）
  • 净消费 = 实际扣费 − 退款（仅 HappyHorse 1.0）
  • 活动期：北京时间 2026-05-08 20:00 — 2026-05-15 20:00
  • 结算时间：5 月 16 日批量发放至账户额度

怎么参与

  1. 登录 hiapi 账号
  2. 充值后调用 happyhorse-1-0 模型生成视频
  3. 消费金额自动累计，5 月 16 日完成发放，无需报名

常见问题

需要报名吗？ 不需要，活动期内调用 HappyHorse 1.0 即自动参与。

返出的额度有限制吗？ 永久有效，调用任意模型均可使用。

退款怎么算？ 按净消费计算（已扣费 − 退款），不会因退款重复返额。

什么时候到账？ 活动结束后次日（5/16）批量发放，单次记录入账。

  • 文本与首尾帧：从提示词开始创作，也可以指定起始画面和结束画面，让镜头方向更明确。
  • 多种参考素材：图片、视频、音频、文件或网页内容都能成为创作参考，适合保持主体、风格与叙事线索。
  • 画质与声音：支持 480P、720P、1080P 输出，并可按需生成同步音频。

适合这些创作

  • 用多张产品图、人物图或场景图组织一支连贯短片。
  • 把网页、方案文件或已有视频素材延展成新的视觉叙事。
  • 为品牌内容、社交媒体和创意提案快速验证镜头与声音方向。

如何参与

  1. 进入 Wan 3.0 模型页。
  2. 输入创作描述，并按需加入首尾帧或参考素材。
  3. 选择输出分辨率和声音设置，在活动期内提交任务，系统自动按 8 折结算。

活动规则

  • 适用于全部注册用户，无需领取优惠券。
  • 活动模型为 wan3.0-video。
  • 本优惠不与其他模型价格活动叠加。
  • 活动截止时间为 2026 年 9 月 3 日 12:00（北京时间）。
